defaults.d: none needed: scores and progress live in the app
defaults.c: Saturated palette from the game's world, with text colours checked against it
defaults.t: Real gameplay capture, age rating, clear in-app purchase terms, privacy for children where it applies
defaults.b: No booking; free to start with clear purchases

rows: Gaming
game, gaming, studio, players, release, trailer, platforms, community
Show real gameplay in the first screen, platforms and release date. Be plain about purchases and age ratings.
Casual Puzzle Game
puzzle game, puzzle, puzzles, casual, match three, levels, brain teaser, relaxing, hints
Teach in one level. Hints and lives must not feel like a trap, and colour choices need a colour-blind option.
Trivia & Quiz Game
trivia, quiz, questions, leaderboard, categories, multiplayer, score, timer
Questions must be accurate and sourced. Show timers kindly and let people play without an account.
Card & Board Game
card game, board game, multiplayer, rules, turns, online, tabletop, cards
Rules in a short tutorial and a readable board. Show whose turn it is in text and allow slow play with notifications.
Idle & Clicker Game
idle game, clicker, incremental, upgrades, offline progress, prestige, numbers, tap
Offline gains must be shown honestly. Keep number formats readable and monetisation clear and capped for children.
Word & Crossword Game
word game, crossword, anagram, letters, daily puzzle, dictionary, hints, streak
Type that stays crisp for long play. Give a daily puzzle without pressure, with hints and a high-contrast mode.
Arcade & Retro Game
arcade, retro game, pixel, high score, controls, 8 bit, classic, cabinet
Controls must feel instant on touch. Retro looks are fine when the type is still readable and flashing effects respect the epilepsy guidance.
Music Streaming
music streaming, playlists, albums, artists, player, queue, lyrics, offline
The player is the product: persistent controls, queue and offline downloads. Show artist payment honestly if you claim it.

rows.d: none needed: the library is the interface

rows: Video Streaming/OTT
video streaming, ott, series, films, watchlist, player, subtitles, profiles
Browse by rows with large art, resume at once, and subtitles that are easy to read and adjust. Prices and cancellation must be plain.

rows.d: none needed: the catalogue is the interface

rows: Podcast Platform
podcast, episodes, shows, listen, subscribe, transcript, rss, host
Play from the page, with transcripts and chapters. Offer subscribe links for every major app and an RSS feed.
News/Media Platform
news, media, articles, breaking, editorial, subscription, paywall, journalism
Headlines, bylines and dates come first; reading width and type matter more than layout tricks. Paywalls must say what is free.

rows: Magazine/Blog
magazine, blog, articles, essays, writers, categories, subscribe, archive
A clear reading column, good type and honest dates. Show categories and a subscribe option that does not interrupt reading.

rows.s: Editorial Grid / Magazine + Minimalism & Swiss Style

rows: Newsletter Platform
newsletter, subscribers, issues, writers, paid, archive, email, growth
Show a sample issue and the archive. Writers need clear export of their list and a fair payment cut.
Social Media App
social media, feed, posts, profiles, follow, messages, community, share
Show moderation and reporting as clearly as the feed. Give controls for blocking, muting and data export.
Chat & Messaging App
messaging, chat, groups, encryption, voice, attachments, contacts, notifications
Explain encryption in plain terms: who can read what. Delivery state must be clear and large text supported.
Dating App
dating, matches, profiles, swipe, chat, safety, verification, preferences
Safety features come first: verification, reporting and blocking. Avoid manipulative streaks and be clear on what is paid.
Anonymous Community / Confession
anonymous, confession, community, posts, moderation, safety, support, privacy
Anonymity needs strong moderation, a visible report path and crisis resources. State what is stored and for how long.
Local Events & Discovery
local events, whats on, tickets, near me, map, categories, weekend, discover
Today and this weekend, near you, filtered by price and type. Every event needs a date, place and ticket link.
Study Together / Virtual Coworking
study together, virtual coworking, focus rooms, pomodoro, accountability, video, study
Show rooms with what is happening now, rules for cameras and chat, and a quiet default. Moderation matters for young users.
Forum / Discussion Board
forum, discussion, threads, replies, moderation, topics, members, boards
Thread structure and search matter most. Show moderators, rules and how to report, and make long threads navigable by keyboard.
Q&A Community Platform
q&a, questions, answers, votes, reputation, tags, accepted answer, experts
Show the question, accepted answer and date. Reputation systems need guards against gaming, and edits need history.
Wiki / Encyclopedia
wiki, encyclopedia, articles, references, edit history, categories, search, knowledge
Citations, edit history and talk pages are the trust signals. Keep the reading column wide enough and navigation consistent.
Membership/Community
membership, community, members only, forums, events, perks, subscription, creators
Say what members get this month. Give a taster, show real recent activity, and make leaving easy.
Creator Economy Platform
creator, subscriptions, tips, fans, payouts, memberships, content, monetise
Show creator earnings only as real examples with dates. State fees, payout times and rights over content.
Citizen Science Platform
citizen science, volunteers, observations, projects, data, species, research, contribute
Show what the data is used for and give volunteers credit. Make a first contribution possible in a minute.
